lines.zh: : 那什么能让你兴奋，Sensei？

lines.en: : Well, for one...not calling me Sensei anymore would help.
lines.zh: : 嗯，首先……别再叫我 Sensei 会有帮助。

lines.en: scene chikafirstlust25
: Wait, really? Then...what would you like me to call you instead?
lines.zh: : 等等，真的？那……你想让我叫你什么？

lines.en: : How about...
lines.zh: : 要不……
